definitions.explanation: The sixth sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly August 23 to September 22. Also the constellation Virgo. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星座|せいざ}→星座：06313_seiza⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{乙女座|おとめざ}だ。
{乙女座|おとめざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧きちょうめんだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Virgo people are often said to be meticulous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乙女座|おとめざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はかどる⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧だそうだ。
examples.english: Today's Virgo horoscope says it's a day when detailed work will go smoothly.

notes:
The zodiac sign Virgo, for people born from late August to late September.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乙女座|おとめざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person born under Virgo
- {乙女座|おとめざ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born a Virgo
- {乙女座|おとめざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: the Virgo horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments (⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧).
